ig_caption:
One user can burn your whole LLM budget 💸 (500 requests in half a second)

AI wrote this chatbot API:
⚠️ every request goes straight to the model
⚠️ no limit per user

One script, or one bored user, can loop it all day. Every call is tokens, and tokens are money. (Demo: $7.50 in 0.5 s at an example price of $0.01 per 1K tokens.)

The fix:
✅ a per-user rate limit: 10 requests/minute
✅ everything above that gets HTTP 429

Same script → 10 answered, 490 refused, and a real user still gets through. Total: $0.20.

In AI apps, every request has a price. Put a limit on it.

Do you rate-limit your LLM endpoints? 👇 Follow to see this chatbot reach production 🚀

#genai #llm #python #devops #ai
yt_title: LLM API rate limiting: one user can burn your budget #genai
yt_description:
Demo (local Python API, model call stubbed, example price $0.01 per 1K tokens, 1,500 tokens per answer):
- no limit: one user sends 500 requests in ~0.5 s → 750,000 tokens → $7.50
- per-user rate limit (10 requests / 60 s, HTTP 429 above): 10 answered, 490 refused; a normal user is unaffected → $0.20

Also worth adding in production: token budgets per user, max_tokens per request, and spend alerts.

Part of the "AI App to Production" journey: one AI chatbot from laptop to production. Follow along.
